criterion: A repo is a target when one of its workflows ships something that leaves the repo: a deploy to a host or to GitHub Pages, a publish to npm, an rsync to the VPS, or a published GitHub release. Only those workflows are watched. CI gates, catalog notifiers, link checks and validators are excluded on purpose — a red CI on a branch is ordinary and routing it here would drown the signal. A repo with no ship workflow gets nothing, permanently.
workflowsAreMatchedByName: Values are each workflow's `name:` field, which is what GitHub's workflow_run filter matches — not the filename. Rename a workflow and its entry here goes stale silently; scripts/rollout-deploy-alert.sh --audit catches that.
